topic.angle: Coins on the Red Sea trade route

card.title: Coins from Aksum, found in India

body.claim: During the reign of Endybis (270-310), Aksum began minting coins that have been excavated as far away as Caesarea and southern India.
body.why: Aksum became a major power on the trade route between Rome and India. Trade across the Red Sea, spanning from the Roman Empire in the north to India and Ceylon in the east, played a crucial role in Aksum's prosperity.

probes.question: Aksum was a major power on the trade route between which two places?
